{{Current events|year=2022|month=01|day=7|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Kazakh protests]]
**[[President of Kazakhstan|Kazakh president]] [[Kassym-Jomart Tokayev]] issues his security forces a [[deadly force|shoot-to-kill]] without warning order in an attempt to end the ongoing protests. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kazakh-president-says-constitutional-order-has-mostly-been-restored-2022-01-07/ (Reuters)]
**The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Ministry of Defense]] reports that [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian troops]] deployed to [[Kazakhstan]] have maintained control of the [[Almaty International Airport]] and secured critical [[government of Kazakhstan|government]] buildings in [[Nur-Sultan]], including the [[Ak Orda Presidential Palace]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-01-05/russia-led-bloc-to-send-troops-to-kazakhstan-kremlin-says (Bloomberg)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/01/07/world/asia/kazakhstan-protests.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Chongqing explosion]]
**Sixteen people are killed and 10 others injured by a gas [[explosion]] in [[Chongqing]], [[China]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/01/08/asia/china-gas-explosion-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Health and environment''' 
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[COVID-19 testing]]
*****The [[Food and Drug Administration (Philippines)|Food and Drug Administration]] begins accepting requests for certification of [[COVID-19]] [[antigen]] test kits for home use. Previously, antigen test kits were only available for professional use. [http://cnnphilippines.com/news/2022/1/7/COVID-19-self-test-kit-antigen-Philippines-FDA.html (CNN Philippines)] 
****The [[Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases]] places 14 more provinces and cities under Alert Level 3 from January 9 to January 15. Five areas including [[Metro Manila]] were already placed into Alert Level 3 due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1537208/14-more-areas-to-be-under-alert-level-3-starting-jan-9 (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] declares a quasi-[[state of emergency]] for [[Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]], [[Yamaguchi Prefecture|Yamaguchi]], and [[Hiroshima Prefecture|Hiroshima]] prefectures, which host [[United States Forces Japan|U.S. military base]]s and are reporting an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases. The quasi-emergency measures will take effect on January 9. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2022/01/d8bdde67e7e1-japan-to-impose-covid-quasi-emergency-on-3-areas-hosting-us-bases.html (Kyodo News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Sri Lanka]]
****[[Sri Lanka]] begins its [[COVID-19 vaccination]] rollout for children between the ages of 12 and 15 years using the [[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2022-01-sri-lanka-vaccinates-children-doctors.html (MedicalXpress)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]]n [[Chancellor of Austria|chancellor]] [[Karl Nehammer]] tests positive for COVID-19 and begins a period of self-isolation. [https://www.politico.eu/article/austrian-chancellor-karl-nehammer-tests-positive-for-covid-19/ (Politico.eu)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bulgaria]], [[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[Bulgaria]] imposes a rule that requires almost all travellers aged above 12 years from the [[European Union]] and the [[United Kingdom]] to have a negative [[PCR]] test in the previous 72 hours along with a [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic|valid COVID-19 certificate]] prior to arrival, in order to limit the spread of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]]. [https://www.euronews.com/travel/2022/01/06/bulgaria-tightens-travel-restrictions-as-covid-infections-surge (Euronews)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany|German]] [[Chancellor of Germany|chancellor]] [[Olaf Scholz]] and the leaders of 16 [[States of Germany|states]] agree to reduce the isolation period for people who have received a [[booster dose]] of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] and also toughen the requirement to enter bars and restaurants to include a booster shot or a negative test result in addition to proof of [[COVID-19 vaccination in Germany|vaccination]] or recovery as the Omicron variant continues to spread across the country. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/germany-mulls-covid-restrictions-omicron-advances-82129989 (ABC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New South Wales]]
****[[New South Wales]] [[Premier of New South Wales|premier]] [[Dominic Perrottet]] announces that the [[Australian states|state]] will suspend [[Elective surgery|elective surgeries]] as well as ban singing and dancing in [[Hospitality industry|hospitality venues]], entertainment facilities and major recreation facilities due to an increase in the number of [[COVID-19]] cases caused by the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]]. These restrictions will be in effect until January 27. [https://www.news.com.au/world/coronavirus/australia/nightclubs-to-close-elective-surgery-paused-as-nsw-considers-new-restrictions/news-story/3d2a2a51df49b2b72c33f4935a6e1b0a (News.com.au)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Northern Territory]]
****The [[Northern Territory]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 412 new cases of COVID-19, bringing the territory-wide total of confirmed cases to 1,686. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-01-07/nt-covid-surge-community-transmission/100743390 (ABC News Australia)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
***[[Argentina]] reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 110,553 new cases of COVID-19. [https://www.infobae.com/sociedad/2022/01/07/covid-imparable-argentina-registro-un-nuevo-record-con-110533-nuevos-contagios-en-un-dia/ (''Infobae'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
***[[Mexico|Mexican]] health regulator [[COFEPRIS]] grants emergency use authorization for [[Merck & Co.]]'s anti-COVID-19 drug [[Molnupiravir]] for the treatment of severe disease. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/mexico-grants-emergency-use-approval-mercks-covid-19-pill-2022-01-07/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nigeria]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Nigeria]]
***[[President of Nigeria|Nigerian President]] [[Muhammadu Buhari]] announces that [[Nigeria]] is working on developing its own [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2022/01/07/africa/nigeria-working-covid-vaccine-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Murder of Ahmaud Arbery]]
**The three [[defendant]]s [[criminal conviction|convicted]] in the [[murder of Ahmaud Arbery]] are [[sentence (law)|sentenced]] to [[life in prison]]. Travis and Greg McMichael are sentenced to life without the possibility of [[parole]], while William Bryan is sentenced to life with the possibility of parole. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/three-men-convicted-murdering-ahmaud-arbery-sentenced-life-prison-rcna10901 (NBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**Researchers from the [[University of Bern]] announce the discovery of [[TOI-2257 b]], an eccentric [[exoplanet]] that orbits near a [[red dwarf]]. [https://phys.org/news/2022-01-eccentric-exoplanet.amp (Phys.org)]
